hdfv.jei.cnc_modules: A CNC is built round its cabinet: 4 wide, 3 deep, 3 high (/hdfv dev place cnc shows one). Bed, guards and frame; the work holding is a plain bed (3 axes), a rotary table (4), a trunnion (5) or a turning spindle (a mill-turn); a B-axis head makes a mill-turn 5; a sub-spindle and turrets (one with Y) take it to 12. Five axes together cut blades, impellers and angled micro-holes; more axes mean fewer setups and quicker work; turning needs a turning spindle.

hdfv.jei.machine.manual: A manual machine tool. Put a part blueprint in the drawing slot and stock or workpieces in the inputs; it does the steps of the drawing it can, to its precision, only while someone works it (its screen open, standing by it). Steps too fine for it need a CNC. Arrows choose which component it starts.
hdfv.jei.machine.forming: Casts, forges, rolls, lays up and cures, or vulcanizes the components of a part blueprint from stock, by itself. Arrows choose which component it starts.
hdfv.jei.machine.cnc: Reads the blueprint and machines to the finest grades, the only machine for complex shapes (blades, injector orifices, cooling holes). Runs unattended; hoppers can feed it.
hdfv.jei.machine.welding_station: Welds formed sheet into components while a player or a welder villager works it. A welder's job site; in an assembly room each worked welding station is one of the crew.
hdfv.jei.machine.assembly_bench: Puts a part together from every finished component of its blueprint (engines, gearboxes, axles, propellers...) while someone works it. Bodies and wings are built in assembly rooms.
hdfv.jei.tool.lathe: Lathe (a multiblock, 0.9): seen from the operator, the headstock (this block) at the left over its drive; the bed runs right a metre a segment (1 to 6: the length it turns; it swings 0.5 m), a cell over each segment for an accessory, the tailstock over the bed's end. /hdfv dev place lathe places one.
hdfv.jei.tool.milling_machine: Milling machine (a multiblock, 0.9): the column and knee (this block) at the left over its drive, the head on top; the table runs right a metre a segment (1 to 4: the longest work; 0.5 m wide and high), each segment taking an accessory. /hdfv dev place milling_machine places one.
hdfv.jei.tool.planer: Planer (a multiblock, 0.9): the drive at the bed's end; the housing (two uprights, the front one this block, the cross rail on top) over the bed's first segment, then 1 to 7 more (work 2 to 8 m long, 1 m wide, 0.9 m high). A side head may take the back upright's place, a second tool head the rail's middle. /hdfv dev place planer places one.
hdfv.jei.tool.boring_mill: Horizontal boring mill (a multiblock, 0.9): the saddle (this block) with its drive behind and the table (or a rotary table) beside it, the column 1 to 4 courses up (the work's height; 1.5 m square), the head on top; a digital readout behind the column, a facing head over the work. /hdfv dev place boring_mill places one.
hdfv.jei.tool.drill_press: Drill press (a multiblock, 0.9): the base (this block) with its drive behind and the table (or a jig plate) beside it, the column 1 to 3 courses up (a radial drill as it grows, for bigger work), the head and spindle (or a multi-spindle head) on top; a power feed behind the column. /hdfv dev place drill_press places one.
hdfv.jei.tool.power: Power comes in only by its drive: the motor seat on a cable (Forge Energy), the pulley seat on a line shaft; change the block to change the power. Its screen says when the work does not fit or an accessory is missing; a 0.8 single-block machine in an old world becomes an unbuilt headstock.
hdfv.jei.tool_members: A manual machine tool's members (0.9): beds, tables, columns, cross rails, heads and spindles. Set round the machine's block as its pattern says, it forms, and the machine's block then draws the whole machine.
hdfv.jei.drive.motor_drive: Motor seat: a manual machine tool's drive (one to a machine). On a cable it feeds the machine Forge Energy. Use it to see what it drives.
hdfv.jei.drive.pulley_drive: Pulley seat: a manual machine tool's drive (one to a machine). On a line shaft it belts the machine round. Use it to see what it drives.
hdfv.jei.accessory.lathe_tailstock: Tailstock (over the lathe bed's end): supports a long shaft; work longer than 4 diameters needs it to be turned or ground.
hdfv.jei.accessory.steady_rest: Steady rest (over the lathe bed): holds a slender shaft's middle; work longer than 12 diameters needs it.
hdfv.jei.accessory.toolpost_grinder: Tool-post grinder (over the lathe bed): a lathe grinds only with one (journals, valve stems...).
hdfv.jei.accessory.quick_change_post: Quick-change tool post (over the lathe bed): 40 % less setting up for each batch.
hdfv.jei.accessory.dividing_head: Dividing head (on the milling table): milling all the way round a part (gears, splines, cams) needs it.
hdfv.jei.accessory.mill_rotary_table: Rotary table (on the milling table): all four sides milled in one clamping.
hdfv.jei.accessory.second_tool_head: Second tool head (the planer rail's middle): two tools cut at once, 40 % less planing time.
hdfv.jei.accessory.side_head: Side head (in the planer's back upright's place): the sides planed in the top's clamping.
hdfv.jei.accessory.boring_rotary_table: Rotary table (in the boring mill table's place): all four sides bored in one clamping.
hdfv.jei.accessory.facing_head: Facing head (over the boring mill's work): bores wider than 0.25 m need it.
hdfv.jei.accessory.multi_spindle_head: Multi-spindle head (in the drill's spindle's place): three holes or more drilled at once, in a third of the time.
hdfv.jei.accessory.power_feed: Power feed (behind the drill's column): 30 % less drilling time.
hdfv.jei.accessory.jig_plate: Jig plate (in the drill table's place): drilled holes a grade finer, 15 % quicker.
hdfv.jei.accessory.digital_readout: Digital readout (a lathe's or mill's accessory cell, behind a boring mill's column): turning, milling and boring a grade finer, 15 % quicker.
hdfv.jei.tool.grinder: Grinder (0.17 multiblock): the control column (this block) over its drive, the bed a metre a segment (1 to 4) to the right with an accessory cell over each, the head's cell over the bed's end: cylindrical, internal, surface, centreless or tool and cutter grinding. /hdfv dev place grinder cylindrical places one.
hdfv.jei.tool.finisher: Finisher (0.17 multiblock): the base (this block) with its drive behind, the table and the work's room over it, the column a course at a time (1 to 3), the top with the head's cell over the table: honing, lapping, polishing or deburring. /hdfv dev place finisher honing.
hdfv.jei.tool.gear_cutter: Gear cutter (0.17 multiblock): the base, table and column as the finisher's (1 to 3 courses: gears 0.3 m across a course more), the head's cell over the table: hobbing, shaping, shaving, grinding or chamfering. /hdfv dev place gear_cutter hobbing.
hdfv.jei.tool.ram_machine: Ram machine (0.17 multiblock): the column (this block) over its drive, the bed a segment of stroke at a time (1 to 3) with a dividing head's cell over each, the head's cell at its end: shaper, slotter or broach. /hdfv dev place ram_machine broaching.
hdfv.jei.tool.sawing_machine: Sawing machine (0.17 multiblock): the control box (this block) over its drive, the stock bed a metre a segment (1 to 3) with a bar feeder's or mitre vise's cell over each, the head's cell at its end: band, cold or hack saw. /hdfv dev place sawing_machine band_saw.
hdfv.jei.tool.electro_machine: Electrical machining centre (0.17 multiblock, numerically controlled, electricity only): the generator (this block) over its motor seat or NC drive, the work tank a segment at a time (1 to 3), the head's cell over its end: sinker EDM, wire EDM, EDM hole drilling or ECM. /hdfv dev place electro_machine wire_edm.
hdfv.jei.tool.cutting_table: Cutting table (0.17 multiblock, numerically controlled): two rows of slats a metre a segment (1 to 6; plate 2 m wide), the drive in front with a fume extractor's or bevel head's cell behind it, the console (this block) over the drive and the head's cell over the table's end: laser (and its electricity), plasma (electricity) or waterjet. /hdfv dev place cutting_table laser.
hdfv.jei.tool.threader: Threading machine (0.17 multiblock): the controller (this block) over its drive, the base beside it with the head's cell on it and a bar feeder's cell at its end: thread rolling, flat dies, tapping or thread milling. /hdfv dev place threader tapping.
hdfv.jei.tool.riveter: Riveter (0.17 multiblock): the controller (this block) over its drive, the frame a segment of throat at a time (1 to 3), the head's cell at its end: squeeze, impact or automatic drilling and riveting. /hdfv dev place riveter squeeze_riveter.
hdfv.jei.accessory.diamond_dresser: Diamond dresser (a grinder's accessory cell): dresses the wheel as it works: 10 % less grinding time, half the wheel lost to dressing.
hdfv.jei.accessory.magnetic_chuck: Magnetic chuck (a grinder's accessory cell): holds iron and steel for the surface grinding head; without it they cannot be surface-ground.
hdfv.jei.accessory.auto_loader: Automatic loader (behind a gear cutter's column): halves the clamping of each piece.
hdfv.jei.accessory.bar_feeder: Bar feeder (a saw's or threader's accessory cell): feeds the stock: the clamping cut to 0.3 and 30 % less sawing or threading.
hdfv.jei.accessory.mitre_vise: Mitre vise (a saw's accessory cell): holds tube at an angle; tube is cut only with it (a space frame's mitres).
hdfv.jei.accessory.electrode_changer: Electrode changer (an electrical machine's accessory cell): every face in one setup.
hdfv.jei.accessory.fume_extractor: Fume extractor (behind a cutting table's drive): the laser and the plasma torch cut only under extraction.
hdfv.jei.accessory.bevel_head: Bevel head (behind a cutting table's drive): tilts the head: angled edges and holes (five axes).
hdfv.jei.machining.manual: Needs an operator (an NC drive runs it alone)
hdfv.jei.drive.nc_drive: NC drive (0.17): a drive cell with its motor and a numerical control: it takes cables like the motor seat, runs the machine with no one at it, one IT grade finer (not with a readout as well), 15 % quicker, 1 kW more while it works. Any machine tool or family takes it; an electrical machining centre takes only this or the motor seat.
hdfv.jei.heads: Machining heads (0.17): the one head in its family's head cell decides what the machine is (two kinds: it does not form). The machining page shows what each does and to which IT grade, and what it uses up.
hdfv.jei.supplies: Consumables (0.17): put in a machine's consumable slots (hoppers can feed them; nothing comes out). Tool sets, wheels, stones, blades, electrodes, wire and gas cylinders wear by their use (Taylor tool life, grinding ratio, electrode wear...); compound, electrolyte, garnet and rivets are used up whole. A dull tool set is reground on the tool grinder (5 times for high-speed steel, 3 for cermet). The server's consumables option turns them off.
hdfv.jei.air_separation_unit: Air separation unit (0.17): takes electricity by cable and empty gas cylinders (by hand or hopper), fills them with oxygen, nitrogen or argon (sneak-use to switch) at 10 kg an hour of work (argon 0.56 kg): about 0.47 kWh a kilogram of oxygen, 0.26 of nitrogen, 0.82 of argon. Used empty-handed it tells its state and hands out the full cylinders.
hdfv.air_separator.status: %s: %s, %s/%s kg in the cylinder, %s empty cylinders, %s FE
hdfv.smelter.state.no_recipe: Put in what a batch takes
hdfv.jei.workpiece: A component on its way through the workshop: its design, which component and how many of its steps are done.
hdfv.jei.part: A finished part, made on an assembly bench: what an assembly room puts into a vehicle.
hdfv.jei.vehicle_blueprint: A whole vehicle's layout, saved in an assembly room's screen and loaded into another.
hdfv.jei.controller.hangar: Set in the wall of a closed room of assembly floor, its front inside. Scans the room; lays out a vehicle for aircraft (its door onto a clear apron) from part blueprints; builds it from the parts, components and stock in the room's chests, with a crane for heavy parts and welding stations worked by players or welders; rolls it out.
hdfv.jei.controller.shipyard: Set in the wall of a closed room of assembly floor, its front inside. Scans the room; lays out a vehicle for boats (a slipway on the floor, its door onto water) from part blueprints; builds it from the parts, components and stock in the room's chests, with a crane for heavy parts and welding stations worked by players or welders; rolls it out.
hdfv.jei.controller.car_factory: Set in the wall of a closed room of assembly floor, its front inside. Scans the room; lays out a vehicle for cars (its door at floor level) from part blueprints; builds it from the parts, components and stock in the room's chests, with a crane for heavy parts and welding stations worked by players or welders; rolls it out.
hdfv.jei.room_blocks: Builds an assembly room: assembly floor underfoot, a crane rail in the roof, hangar doors, roller shutters or dock gates in a wall, a slipway in a shipyard.
hdfv.jei.refining.basis: Per %s kg of feed; burns %s %%; %s kWh/t (nominal)
hdfv.jei.power.battery: A 50 kWh nickel-iron battery bank: it takes and gives Forge Energy (up to 10 kW) through cables.
hdfv.jei.power.generator: A 50 kW generator: driven by the line shaft it touches, it feeds the cables (about 95 % efficient).
hdfv.jei.power.electric_motor: A 15 kW electric motor: from the cables it turns the line shaft it touches.
hdfv.jei.power.steam_engine: A 15 kW mill steam engine: burns coal, charcoal, coke or wood and turns the line shaft it touches. The way to start a workshop.
hdfv.jei.power.treadle: A treadle: about 75 W from a player (or a villager) working it, onto the line shaft it touches.
hdfv.jei.power.engine_stand: An engine stand: put a finished engine and fuel in it; its governor holds the line shaft at speed and it burns the fuel its engine map says.
hdfv.jei.power.creative_power: Creative power: endless Forge Energy and shaft power to whatever touches it.
hdfv.jei.cable: Cables carry Forge Energy between generators, batteries and machines: light (6 mm², about 25 kW) and heavy (95 mm²). A network carries no more than its weakest cable.
hdfv.jei.line_shaft: A line shaft at 250 rpm: belts drive the manual machine tools; too much load slows it and the machines with it.
hdfv.jei.fluid_pipe: Pipes join tanks, pumps and the plant; a pump pushes along them (about 5 l/s against 40 m).
hdfv.jei.fluid_tank: A 1000 l tank; stacked tanks are one column.
hdfv.jei.pump: An electric pump: draws from behind and delivers in front, on Forge Energy.
hdfv.jei.storage_tank: A storage tank: walls round a valve, a roof on top; 9000 l for each course of wall.
hdfv.jei.jerry_can: 20 l of a fluid: fills from a tank, a dispenser or an outlet; pours into a vehicle (use it on the vehicle) or, sneaking, into a tank.
hdfv.jei.oil_seep: Oil seeping up: an oil field is somewhere below. Survey with the geophone.
hdfv.jei.geophone: Use it on the ground: it tells whether an oil field lies below, how deep, how much is left, whether it flows, and where its middle is.
hdfv.jei.drilling_rig: The drilling rig: floor, rotary table, derrick and crown block round its drawworks (75 kW). It drills at the rock's rate, uses steel for casing, and sets a wellhead when it strikes oil. Its screen (0.9) sets a target depth: short of a field it stops there (a dry hole); set it deeper to drill on.
hdfv.jei.wellhead: The wellhead: flows by itself while the field has pressure; then it needs a pump jack. Pipe the crude away. Its screen (0.9) sets the choke: wide open or 8 to 64/64 in; the smaller the choke the less it flows.
hdfv.jei.pump_jack: The pump jack: its gearbox, crank, Samson post, walking beam and horsehead round a wellhead; on Forge Energy. Its screen (0.9) sets the strokes a minute (4 to 15), the stroke and the plunger: the more it displaces the more it lifts, up to what the field gives.
hdfv.jei.distillation_column: The crude distillation column: the fired heater and this panel at the bottom, an outlet on each tray section, the column top; a vacuum section turns the residue into bitumen. Used empty-handed it opens its screen (0.9): running, throughput, the naphtha, kerosene and diesel cut points, the vacuum section on or off, which product each outlet takes, and its yields; used sneaking it shows its status.
hdfv.jei.process_unit: A process unit: three reactor blocks of one kind over this panel, outlets either side; the reactors decide what it makes. Used empty-handed it opens its screen (0.9): running, throughput, which product each outlet takes, the FCC's riser outlet temperature (presets for diesel, gasoline and olefins), the reformer's octane, the cracker's coil outlet temperature, the polymer plant's product; its yields are AeroCore's at those conditions.
hdfv.jei.unit_outlet: An outlet's drum (4000 l): a unit's product waits here for a pump.
hdfv.jei.fuel_dispenser: The fuel dispenser: 2000 l of one fuel (by pipe or can). Its screen (0.9) sets a fill-up or 10, 20 or 50 l and starts it; it pumps 50 l a minute, refusing a fuel the vehicle's engines do not burn; used sneaking it starts or stops at once. Vehicles leave an assembly room with empty tanks.
hdfv.jei.cryogenic_tank: Holds 800 l, kept cold inside 50 mm of vacuum multilayer insulation: liquid hydrogen boils off at well under 1 % a day (in a bare tank a cubic metre is gone within the hour of work). Stacks only with its own kind; takes no 700 bar hydrogen.
hdfv.jei.hydrogen_cylinders: Carbon-wound cylinders for 700 bar hydrogen: 500 l of gas (about 20 kg). Takes nothing else.
hdfv.jei.hydrogen_liquefier: Pipe 700 bar hydrogen in, draw liquid hydrogen out: 10 kg an hour of work for 11.9 kWh a kilogram of electricity.
hdfv.jei.grain: A kilogram of solid propellant. Used on a vehicle, grains load its empty boosters of the same propellant, as many as each one's grain weighs.
hdfv.jei.reed_set: Spring-steel reeds for a pulsejet's valve. Used on a vehicle, replaces the worn reeds of its pulsejets (one set each).
hdfv.jei.handbook: The handbook: right-click to read it. From ores and smelting through machine tools, CNC and engine design to building, driving and flying; its entries tick off as you get the advancements. New players get one.
hdfv.jei.alloy_furnace: The alloy furnace: burns fuel to make coke from coal, steel and other stock from ingots, and the early chemicals. Hoppers can feed it and take its output.
hdfv.jei.smelter: An electric smelting machine: four inputs, the product and two by-products; it takes Forge Energy by cable and spends the kWh each batch needs.
hdfv.jei.paint_booth: The paint booth's controller: set in the wall of a closed room, scans it like an assembly room. Drive a finished vehicle in, choose colours and stickers (pictures you upload), and it paints with paint cans and sticker film, taking time and electricity.
hdfv.jei.refit_shop: The refit shop's controller: set in the wall of a closed room. Drive a finished car in and change its shape, size, aero kit, rims, tuning and lamps; the shop checks it again, fits the new parts from its chests and swaps the car where it stands, keeping its fuel.
hdfv.jei.control_tower: The control tower's controller: the tower is a multiblock that can be built taller (higher sees and reaches farther). On electricity it runs radar, ATIS, the runway lights and clearances; a controller villager works it, or a player takes over at its desk.
hdfv.jei.more_in_handbook: More in the Vehicle Engineering Handbook.
hdfv.layout.move.x: Move along x (forward): 0.1 m, 1 m with Shift
hdfv.layout.move.y: Move along y (up): 0.1 m, 1 m with Shift
hdfv.layout.move.z: Move along z (starboard): 0.1 m, 1 m with Shift
hdfv.layout.roll.tip: Roll 15 degrees, 90 with Shift (a fin, a tail rotor)
hdfv.jei.design_table: Right-click to open the design screen. Hold a blueprint to edit it; saving overwrites it, otherwise saving uses a blank blueprint from your inventory.
hdfv.jei.design_tablet: The design screen anywhere: right-click. A blueprint in the other hand is opened for editing.
hdfv.jei.blank_blueprint: Saving a new design in the design screen writes it onto one of these.
hdfv.jei.blueprint: One part design. Right-click to open it in the design screen.
hdfv.jei.labour: Fitting: %s h of work (a fitter at the bench)
hdfv.jei.smelting: %s kWh at %s kW: %s h of work
hdfv.jei.component: A standard component: save its drawing from the design screen (Standard components), put it in the machines with stock; the last machine of its route hands out the component.
hdfv.jei.component.a: Grade A: the foundry and the forging press only (castings, forgings, rolled sheet, wire)
hdfv.jei.component.b: Grade B: the lathe, the drill press and the planer
hdfv.jei.component.c: Grade C: the milling machine, the boring mill, the grinders, the gear and thread machines, the composite oven
command.hdfv.vehicle.samples: Wrote %s sample blueprint(s) to %s (existing files are kept). Spawn one with /aerocore vehicle spawn <name>.

hdfv.paint_booth.click_to_move: Click on the vehicle to move the sticker there
hdfv.paint_booth.pick_picture: Pick a picture above, or drop one on this screen

hdfv.paint_booth.cancelled: The job was cancelled (what it took is used up)
hdfv.paint_booth.not_looks: Only looks and stickers are changed here
hdfv.paint_booth.need_film: The job needs %s sheets of sticker film

hdfv.paint_booth.failed: The vehicle could not take its new looks

hdfv.paint_booth.problem.door_small: The door is too small: the vehicle is %s m across and %s m high
hdfv.paint_booth.problem.no_exhaust: The booth needs an exhaust fan in its walls or roof

hdfv.paint_booth.problem.no_power: The controller has no power: connect a cable

advancements.hdfv.tutorial.root.title: High Degree of Freedom Vehicles
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.root.descript: Design every part, machine it, build vehicles for land, sea and air. The handbook shows the way.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.ores.title: New Minerals
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.ores.descript: Mine one of the new ores: bauxite, ilmenite, nickel, chromite, magnesite, tin, zinc or garnet.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.alloy_furnace: Build an alloy furnace: coke from coal, steel from iron and coke.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.steel.title: Stock
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.steel.descrip: Get your first stock: the metal the workshop cuts, an ingot of it is 10 kg.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.foundry.title: Cast and Forged
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.foundry.descr: Build a foundry and a forging press: the first standard components are castings and forgings.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.assembly_benc: Build an assembly bench: machines are fitted together from standard components there.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.component.des: Make a grade A standard component: save its drawing, cast or forge it from stock.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.treadle.title: Leg Power
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.treadle.descr: Turn a line shaft with a treadle: about 75 W, enough to learn on.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.lathe.title: The First Lathe
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.lathe.descrip: Form a lathe: its drive, a bed of one to six metres, the headstock on the drive.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.machined.desc: Take your first machined work out of a machine.
Build a mill steam engine: 15 kW on the line shaft from coal, charcoal, coke or wood.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.electricity.d: Build a generator: the line shaft turns it, cables carry Forge Energy.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.arc_furnace.d: Build an arc furnace: alloy and stainless steels, superalloys, titanium.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.aluminium.des: Win aluminium in the electrolysis cell: alumina, a carbon anode and a lot of electricity.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.precision.des: Make a cut gear: grade C components need the milling machine, the grinders and the gear machines.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.cnc.title: Numerical Control
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.cnc.descripti: Form a CNC: the only machine for blades, injector orifices and cooling holes.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.design.title: On the Drawing Board
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.design.descri: Save a design onto a blueprint in the design screen.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.engine_design: Save an engine design: piston, jet, turbofan, turboprop, turboshaft, ramjet, pulsejet or rocket.
Start an engine you built on an engine stand.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.car_factory.d: Make the controller of a car factory: the room where cars are built.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.first_car.des: Roll your first car out of a car factory.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.fuelled.title: Fill Her Up
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.fuelled.descr: Fuel a vehicle from a can or a fuel dispenser: it leaves the factory with empty tanks.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.on_the_road.d: Drive a car you built for a kilometre.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.hundred.title: Ton
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.hundred.descr: Reach 100 km/h in a car you built.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.coupled.title: Fifth Wheel
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.coupled.descr: Couple a trailer to a tractor.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.refit.title: Tuner
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.refit.descrip: Start a refit in a refit shop: shape, size, aero kit, rims, tuning, lamps.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.painted.title: Itasha
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.painted.descr: Start a paint job in a paint booth: colours and your own stickers.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.hangar.title: Hangar
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.hangar.descri: Make the controller of a hangar: aircraft are built there.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.first_aircraf: Roll your first aircraft out of a hangar.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.airborne.desc: Fly an aircraft you built 50 m above the ground.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.control_tower: Make a control tower: radar, ATIS, runway lights and clearances.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.cleared.title: Cleared
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.cleared.descr: Be cleared for takeoff or to land by a control tower.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.mach_one.desc: Go faster than sound in a vehicle you built.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.shipyard.desc: Make the controller of a shipyard: boats are built on its slipway.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.first_boat.de: Launch your first boat from a shipyard.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.sailed.title: Sea Trials
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.sailed.descri: Take a boat you built a kilometre.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.prospected.de: Find an oil field with the geophone.
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.gusher.title: Gusher
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.gusher.descri: Strike oil with a drilling rig (be near it when it does).
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.refined.title: Refinery
advancements.hdfv.tutorial.refined.descr: Be near a distillation column or process unit while it makes products.
hdfv.welcome.title: Welcome to High Degree of Freedom Vehicles!
hdfv.welcome.handbook: You have the Vehicle Engineering Handbook: from your first ore to your first car, aircraft and boat. %s
hdfv.welcome.open.hover: Opens the handbook (or right-click the book)
hdfv.welcome.advancements: The advancements (%s) have a High Degree of Freedom Vehicles tab: it shows the next step.
hdfv.welcome.keys: At the wheel: %s and %s shift up and down, %s is the handbrake, %s couples a trailer, %s calls the tower. All keys: Options, Controls, Key Binds, High Degree of Freedom Vehicles.
